cross16b_entry_contract_update.residual_reason: All three compare the POST-edge sample, where the registered Sbuffer credit has advanced but the external deq window still carries the old controls.
cross16b_entry_contract_update.regression_evidence_state: The authoritative full-suite result is the v3 run (2356 PASS / 219 FAIL, source sha256 69680282...), which includes this contract update.

post_edge_accounting_investigation.problem: The three residual nodes disagree only in the post-edge sample: RTL io_sqDeqCnt is 2, the model expects 1, for the shape ordinary-or-NC lane0 + vecInactive lane1.
post_edge_accounting_investigation.rtl_rule: DeqModule derives deqMask combinationally from the registered sbufferCreditCount and the deq window pins. Old RTL summed per-signal terms and used the RegNext-delayed deqPtrMoveFromSbuffer; upstream 4efe9f034 replaced that with a credit balance plus a deqUsesSbufferCredit prefix mask.
post_edge_accounting_investigation.model_rule: deq/model.py keeps the older sparse formula in the expected(after=True) branch, translated term by term from the pre-4efe9f034 DeqModule.sv. Its deqPtrMoveFromSbuffer_0 equivalent is 'credit_lanes[0] is not None'.

attempts.change: mirror RTL exactly (credit counter + deqUsesSbufferCredit prefix, one formula for both phases)
attempts.why: the model's handleFinish is set by PSQ one cycle after deq.advance(), so a literal RTL copy loses the explicit phase compensation

attempts.change: delete the after branch and use plan() evaluated post-advance
attempts.why: the 9 split-identity nodes depend on the sparse formula's one-cycle lag

attempts.change: after branch: inactive lane1 may join when ANY credit was produced
attempts.why: too permissive; a credit owned by a different SQ is not the prefix Store's credit

attempts.change: after branch: inactive lane1 may join when base is in credit_lanes
attempts.why: base is in credit_lanes in those cases too, so membership alone does not separate the two situations

post_edge_accounting_investigation.conclusion: No local edit fixes these three without regressing others. The correct fix is a redesign of the model's completion accounting to an explicit credit balance with per-phase snapshots, which is more than this regression task authorises and which risks turning the check into a mirror of the RTL.
post_edge_accounting_investigation.decision: Kept as three真实 FAIL. deq/model.py reverted to the verified v3 state.
